mintAuthority.summary: ONED native issuance is role-gated and subject to mutable per-minter rate limits. Separate no-code default-admin and beacon-owner addresses can authorize issuance or replace mint logic; the observed 24-hour default-admin transfer delay is not a global mint or upgrade delay.

controls.label: ONED authorized minter
controls.evidence: At Base block 52095848, hasRole(MINT_ROLE,minter)=true and currentMintLimit(minter)=5000000 ONED. Mint allowance is configurable; this is not an immutable supply ceiling. eth_getCode(controller)=0x. A no-code address does not establish single-person or MPC key custody.

controls.label: ONED default admin
bypassSurfaces: DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE can immediately replace the beacon using upgradeBeaconToAndCall; the 86400-second delay applies only to admin transfer.
controls.evidence: At Base block 52095848, defaultAdmin() returns this address and defaultAdminDelay()=86400 seconds. That delay governs admin transfer, not ordinary minting or a globally timelocked upgrade. Token source exposes role and minter configuration powers. eth_getCode(controller)=0x. A no-code address does not establish single-person or MPC key custody.

controls.label: ONED beacon owner
controls.evidence: At Base block 52095848, Beacon owner() returns this address; implementation()=0x57ab1e54fca80105a93a735b59f850f8420b5e2c. Beacon ownership can replace token logic; token default-admin upgradeBeaconToAndCall is an additional replacement surface. eth_getCode(controller)=0x. A no-code address does not establish single-person or MPC key custody.

review.evidence: Base creation block 44701636 through current block 52110793 complete RoleGranted/RoleRevoked census returned ten grants and no revocations: sole MINT_ROLE=0x026bbff480a3dfde0f60ec525029c746fbb0f485, sole MINT_RATE_LIMIT_ROLE=0x6627aae9c802204695dd323d22fdf437867f4f17, sole DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE=0x9446ce5c9e8b47d7e6cb229a42eaae32d4e8aaf9. Current hasRole checks confirmed mint and rate-limit memberships; both controllers have no code. Beacon owner() was independently re-read as 0x8b6fed2d19076f96004df41c78c771b45f4dc71b. Source grants the default admin immediate beacon replacement and rate-limit mutation; beacon owner can replace the shared implementation, so the raiseable minter allowance does not bound aggregate economic issuance. The 86400-second delay is admin-transfer-only. Coinbase's reserve dashboard does not establish independent financial assurance or prudential supervision; the April Cantina audit is code security only. MPC/HSM safeguards and beneficial signer identity of the mint, rate-limit, default-admin and beacon-owner keys remain undisclosed. Token-specific financial reserve reconciliation process and prudential supervision remain undisclosed; Gennius platform operator terms alone do not resolve regulated issuer identity.
